title: Saddles, Pole Clamps(Stick Clamps) and Accessories for Live Working
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14993) covers Saddles, Pole Clamps(Stick Clamps) and Accessories for Live Working. This Indian Standard which is identical with lEC 1236 ( 1993 ) [ renumbered as lEC 61236 ( 1 993 ) ] 'Saddles, pole clamps (stick clamps) and accessories for live working' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission ( lEC ) was adopted by the of the Tools and Equipment for Live Working Sectional Committee ( ET 36 ) and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council. The text of the lEC standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. In the adopted standard, certain terminology and conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker.
